name: 破晓之门
direction: A strong architectural D-shaped portal with a small rising sun cut into its inner counter at the horizon. One unified bold silhouette, not an illustration. Deep teal and a restrained warm sunrise accent. Calm, welcoming, iconic.

name: TD 字母印记
direction: A bespoke compact TD monogram: T crossbar and D curved bowl share one continuous geometry, clever negative space, subtly asymmetrical but optically balanced. Dark teal single color. Sophisticated typography-led identity, no sun symbol.

name: 晨光折页
direction: Two interlocking folded planes form an abstract opening book and upward dawn beam. Flat geometric shapes only, no 3D rendering. Deep teal with muted mint secondary plane. Crisp confident creative-tool identity, broad simple shapes.

name: 工具星核
direction: Four substantial modular pieces lock around a small negative-space diamond. Suggest a versatile toolkit with a precise engineered silhouette. Not the generic four-point AI sparkle: use four offset interlocking rounded brackets forming a compact pinwheel. Teal monochrome.

name: 日出开关
direction: A bold broken circular switch silhouette where the central vertical bar is a rising ray above a simple horizon. A distinctive fusion of starting a tool and dawn, with few large shapes and careful negative space. Deep teal and amber, no thin rays.

name: 灵感鸟
direction: An elegant abstract lark in flight built from only two bold curved shapes and one negative-space notch. Optimistic morning energy, intelligent tool companion, no eyes or cartoon face, no feather detail. Teal single-color silhouette, memorable even at tiny size.

name: 像素晨曦
direction: A compact stepped rising-sun emblem built from five chunky square modules and one horizontal base. Precise pixel-derived geometry, not a checkerboard, not a grid of many tiny squares. Deep teal with one amber module. Digital craftsmanship and new beginnings.

name: 发现之窗
direction: A compact rounded-square frame with one corner opened into a directional discovery arrow; a simple rising semicircle nested in the opening creates a clever single mark. Strong negative-space composition, minimal teal, no magnifying glass or generic app icon backdrop.

name: 无限工坊
direction: A bold continuous ribbon forms a unique lowercase d-like loop and a short horizontal tool handle. Flat two-dimensional monochrome mark, no gradients, no generic infinity symbol. Smooth confident geometry with a purposeful interruption suggesting dawn light.

name: 纯字标
direction: A custom premium ToolDawn wordmark is the primary logo. Distinctive T and D letterforms, the two o letters form a subtle rising horizon through shared negative space. Keep it instantly readable. Include an isolated bespoke D glyph as the companion favicon. Deep teal only, strong typographic identity, no separate illustrative emblem.
